response.sql: WITH by_name AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), ''), '\N') AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM by_name) SELECT SUM(b.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(b.average_laps) AS average_laps, AVG(b.total_points - m.average_total) AS average_excess_points FROM by_name AS b CROSS JOIN benchmark AS m WHERE b.total_points > m.average_total

assumptions.assumption: The final average laps is the average of the kept race names’ individual average laps. Empty strings and \N in laps are missing values.

alternatives.interpretation: Average laps across all individual results belonging to the kept race names, giving names with more results more weight.
alternatives.sql: WITH by_name AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), ''), '\N') AS REAL)) AS average_laps, COUNT(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), ''), '\N')) AS lap_count FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM by_name) SELECT SUM(b.total_points) AS sum_total_points, SUM(b.average_laps * b.lap_count) / NULLIF(SUM(b.lap_count), 0) AS average_laps, AVG(b.total_points - m.average_total) AS average_excess_points FROM by_name AS b CROSS JOIN benchmark AS m WHERE b.total_points > m.average_total
